title: Important to preserve independence, transparency of Election Commission: Keralam CM Satheesan
summary: In a post on X, Satheesan says voters need to have full confidence in integrity of India’s electoral process

summary: The ECI responded on September 23, saying that all its actions have been in accordance with the laws and instructions of the Commission

title: BJP spent more in Bengal than Congress did across five state polls: EC filings
summary: Bengal accounted for more than half of the BJP's ₹529.38-crore expenditure on the five elections, the other four being in Assam, Keralam, Tamil Nadu and Puducherry; the party spent ₹217.16 crore on general campaigning in Bengal and ₹69.83 crore on candidates.

summary: Justice G.K. Ilanthiraiyan allows a petition filed by the founder of We The Leaders movement to quash the case filed against him by Salem-based activist Piyush Manush

title: Asian Games 2026 LIVE: Roshibina Devi bags second Asian Games silver in Wushu
summary: It is third Asian Games medal for Roshibina, who won a silver at the 2023 Hangzhou Asian Games and a bronze at the 2018 Jakarta-Palembang Games

title: Supreme Court Collegium recommends appointment of 12 additional judges as permanent judges in four High Courts
summary: The collegium also approved the appointment of Justice Subhash Upadhyay, an additional judge, as a permanent judge of the Uttarakhand High Court.

title: Kalyan Court acquits Uddhav Thackeray, Eknath Shinde in 17-year-old defamation case
summary: The court held that records, testimony and statements did not support the charges. It noted gaps in the investigation and in sequence of events, as per the proceedings and advocates.

title: Karnataka special session: Indi Congress MLA’s resignation over drought status embarrasses government
